newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Basketball-Alaska win, tie final series.
newsitem.headline: Basketball-Alaska win, tie final series.

text.p: Alaska Milk routed Formula Shell 93-86 in the second game of the Philippine Basketball Association finals on Friday to square the series 1-1.
The Milkmen stepped up a gear in the second half and tight defense on Shell import Kenny Redfield limited him to only 18 points in the game.
Milkmen import Sean Chambers topped his team's score with 28 points.
The best-of-seven final series is scheduled to resume on Sunday.
